candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. The session records and their refresh tokens stay valid, so a device that was already signed in can still call refreshToken and get new tokens. Other flows, such as the password change in `update`, do call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude. The reset flow has no equivalent call.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. A reset has no current session to exclude, so every device is signed out.
